spec_match.rationale: ChromeStatus feature 5201653661827072 'Upsert' is the TC39 proposal adding Map/WeakMap.prototype.getOrInsert and getOrInsertComputed, but this page demonstrates IndexedDB put() — a different, decades-old API; the feature's own conformance suite tests getOrInsert and this page never touches it.

interactive.rationale: The IndexedDB controls genuinely work — upsert, read, and clear were driven via CDP and the record/log readouts updated correctly — they just exercise the wrong API.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb frames the feature as 'put() in upsert mode … no pre-read required', which matches this page but not the spec's framing (ECMAScript getOrInsert/getOrInsertComputed).

edge_cases.rationale: For the API it actually shows, the page covers create/replace/read/clear; for the actual chromestatus feature it covers nothing.

references.rationale: The chromestatus.com/feature/5201653661827072 link is present (self-heal intact), but the MDN reference points at IDBObjectStore.put, reinforcing the wrong API.

conformance.rationale: The feature-level suite is excellent and immutable — behavioral assertions for insert-on-miss, preserve-on-hit, and computed-only-on-miss; it honestly reports 0 pass / 7 fail in this pre-145 browser because V8 ships getOrInsert in 145.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven end-to-end in headless Chromium 141 via CDP: upsert wrote { id: "my-key" … }, the read-back matched, the store cleared, and the console stayed clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables throughout; no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Key/value inputs rely on placeholder text with no label/aria-label, and the log region is not a live region; buttons are native.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured clean at 360x740 (scrollWidth 360, wide code confined to scrollable pre); desktop 1280 renders without issues.

openQuestions.title: Rebuild this demo around Map.prototype.getOrInsert — the actual v145 feature
openQuestions.detail: The page demonstrates IndexedDB put() while the chromestatus entry, TC39 proposal (tc39/proposal-upsert), and the feature conformance suite are all about Map/WeakMap getOrInsert(Computed). This is a factual error, so an in-place fix is justified under the durable-demo contract: keep the URL, replace the IndexedDB material with an interactive getOrInsert demo (miss-inserts, hit-preserves, computed-only-on-miss, WeakMap variant) with honest pre-145 fallback messaging, update the blurb on the feature index, and swap the MDN put() reference for the proposal/MDN getOrInsert links. The sibling concepts (api-patterns, concurrency-stress, offline-sync) appear built on the same misreading and need the same review.

openQuestions.title: Label the key/value inputs
openQuestions.detail: Both text inputs are placeholder-only; add <label> or aria-label so the form is non-visually operable, and make the log a polite live region.

summary: Mechanically a working, clean demo (verified via CDP: upsert/read/clear all function at 360px and 1280px) — but it demonstrates the wrong API entirely: 'Upsert' in Chrome 145 is TC39 Map.getOrInsert/getOrInsertComputed, exactly what the feature's conformance suite (honestly failing 0/7 in this pre-145 browser) asserts. Classic shallow-research defect; the whole feature folder needs re-pointing at the ECMAScript proposal. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
